title: Aureline M5 archive-export gate
description: Canonical per-domain archive-export gate minted by the last-supported-snapshot and archive-export-gate lane over the frozen M5 retired-state matrix. Blocks a last-supported snapshot / retirement archive bundle from being handed off while it is not export-safe, so a historical reference can never ship carrying a live vendor dependency, a leaked secret / internal-only detail, or a missing binding back to the retirement manifest and review packet. Records the archive-export scope a blocker sits in — a live dependency that would stop the bundle from opening offline (the bundle must be inspectable without live service dependencies), an internal-only or secret leak (the archive must exclude live secrets and internal-only detail while retaining enough evidence for support, audit, and procurement / reference use), or an unbound manifest / review packet (the bundle must bind back to the retirement manifest and review packet so it explains why the surface retired and what replaced it) — and binds the affected last-supported-bundle reference, the affected retirement-manifest reference, the bundle-versus-successor reference, and the active block reason so release, install / update, support, and procurement surfaces read the archive-handoff truth directly rather than re-deriving it by hand. Downstream surfaces point at this schema instead of restating a bundle's export-safety state by hand. Raw secret values and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
